title: IRS GCS Enterprise Standard Edition (v1.1.4)
releaseNotes:
• Standard High-Performance FlyView: Reverted and locked to standard QGroundControl flight cockpit with complete telemetry gauges, flight tools, and guided actions.
• Core Stability: Optimized rendering pipeline and telemetry synchronization.
• Dual Platform Release: Synchronized builds for Windows Desktop and Android Mobile controllers.
